subject: Consolidated analytics renewal & migration plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating analytics renewals — kickoff and ask

Team —

We're staring down renewal windows for Amplitude (product analytics) and Segment (event ingestion) that overlap in Q4. Given our goals (lower unit cost, simpler instrumentation, and fewer vendor SLAs to manage), I'd like a short recommendation and a proposed timeline for:

- Whether we keep both vendors (best-of-breed) or consolidate to a single vendor for both ingestion+analytics.
- Migration scope and risks if we consolidate (dependencies, engineering effort).
- Estimated FY27 spend under each option.

Can Marcus please lead a quick cost/effort comparison and attach any historical usage? Laura — please include any business constraints from Product (dashboards, export needs). Neha — loop in Procurement for preferred commercial terms. Marissa — if you can flag any legal/redline checklist items we should expect.

Request: initial recommendation and a draft mutual action plan by EOD next Friday (2026-07-31).

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating analytics renewals — kickoff and ask

Tessa —

Attached is a first-pass cost/usage export and a high-level effort estimate (see attachments). Quick notes:

- Current annualized spend: Amplitude ~$420k (prod+staging), Segment ~$210k (ingest + cloud CT).
- 70% of our dashboards rely on Amplitude cohorts/experiments; migration to Mixpanel would require event name alignment + conversion of 12 dashboards.
- Segment is used as our universal collector for 50+ services; moving off Segment implies building/owning ingestion and backfilled history.

Options:
A) Dual path (keep both): lowest engineering lift, estimated FY27 cost +5% for committed discounts.
B) Consolidate to Amplitude for both ingestion + analytics (Amplitude recent launches): Medium lift, Amplitude quoted ~650k for combined stack (see vendor quote).
C) Consolidate to Segment+Mixpanel: Higher lift (reinstrumentation), estimated ~480–520k but with 9–12 month migration.

I've attached: cost_comparison_q3_2026.csv and segment_migration_plan.xlsx (skeleton). I'll reach out to vendor contacts for formal quotes and draft SOW.

Thanks — Marcus

Attachments: cost_comparison_q3_2026.csv, segment_migration_plan.xlsx
From: Jordan Reese <jordan@amplitude.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Amplitude renewal — bundled pricing + migration assistance

Hi Tessa / Marcus —

Thanks for the heads up. Attached is our formal renewal quote and a proposed migration assistance addendum. Highlights:

- Annual license for product analytics + ingestion layer (Amplitude Collect) at $650,000 with a 12-month deployment window.
- 10% discount on a 2-year commit.
- Includes 40 hours of Amplitude Professional Services (migration scoping) and a migration playbook.
- Standard terms attached; legal happy to discuss data residency and audit clauses.

If you prefer a phased approach, we can stage ingestion first (Q4) and migrate dashboards in Q1. Let me know if you'd like a Teams call with Product + Engineering next week.

Best,
Jordan Reese
Enterprise Solutions, Amplitude

Jordan —

Quick legal read-through:
- Data residency clause: acceptable but add carve-out for audit logs retention (we need 7 years for certain compliance customers).
- SLA credits: ask for a 2x credit on downtime windows above 99.9% for core ingestion.
- Liability cap: request bump for negligence exclusions.

Also: can you provide a redline-friendly Word/PDF and an editable SOW? If you can send a DocuSign envelope after redlines we're ready to route to Procurement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
